svg.title: TOPAK H7 — The Lean route: a second derivation, in three uses and one kernel
svg.desc: Beside the TLAPS proofs and the floor's gates, three Lean 4 packages prove the same claims again by a different route (ADR-0053, Proposed, drafted 2026.10.05). A re-encoding writes a TLA+ module as a Lean transition system; a transcription writes a function of the reference in Lean; a statement in Cedar's model writes the floor in cedar-spec's syntax. Each is proved by the Lean kernel, and each adds one premise that is read and not checked: that the Lean is what it claims to state. The words stay apart (ADR-0053 §1): TLAPS proves, a certified run certifies, Lean proves in Lean of an encoding, a transcription or a statement, and TLC checks. The TLA+ module, its TLAPS proof and the Rust stay canonical; nothing here is a claim about the running reference (T-0045-28).
svg.text: TOPAK · H7

text.tspan: The Lean route: a second derivation, in three uses and one kernel

svg.text: Beside the TLAPS proofs and the floor's gates, three Lean 4 packages prove the same claims again by a different route (ADR-0053, Proposed, drafted 2026.10.05). A re-encoding writes a TLA+ module as a Lean transition system; a transcription writes a function of the reference in Lean; a statement in Cedar's model writes the floor in cedar-spec's syntax. Each is proved by the Lean kernel, and each adds one premise that is

read and not checked: that the Lean is what it claims to state. The words stay apart (ADR-0053 §1): TLAPS proves, a certified run certifies, Lean proves in Lean of an encoding, a transcription or a statement, and TLC checks. The TLA+ module, its TLAPS proof and the Rust stay canonical; nothing here is a claim about the running reference (T-0045-28).

Not ratified. The kernel and toolchain are proposed as trusted-base row T-0045-37 (§6 below); until then a Lean result is evidence no record cites. The packages, the results and the tooling are the drafter's.

Classical.choice appears in the spec package for NonComposition alone, whose Erase step cases on a set membership as TLA+ does, and in the floor package through cedar-spec's proofs. native_decide appears only in the floor package: the kernel's decide cannot reduce the model's maps and sets, which are built by well-founded recursion (ADR-0053 §2). No sorry anywhere.

text.tspan: 2 · How a Lean result is made, replayed and kept in step (

svg.text: One per package. The floor's first runs gen.py, which regenerates
Genesis.lean and Tests.lean from the floor's files through the cedar
CLI.
The elaborator turns each proof into a term and the kernel checks
every term as it is added. Any failure stops the run.
Every theorem's axioms, joined and sorted so that the file regenerates
byte for byte. Not enough by itself: §3.
Replays every constant the root reaches, Lean's library and cedar-spec
included, through the kernel in a fresh environment, from the stored
build. The same kernel, a separate process.
Every file transcribed and every Lean source by repository path and
digest; the prover line with the kernel's digest; theorems; axioms; the
replay's verdict.
Compares every digest with the tree, and every kernel, toolchain and
cedar-spec commit with tools/LEAN-PIN. IN SYNC, or STALE and exit
STALE: re-read the Lean against what moved, change it if the meaning changed, regenerate

text.tspan: Kept in step, the way the TLAPS proofs are

svg.text: One toolchain for all three packages, cedar-spec's own: the two older packages built unchanged on it.
Every results file names the pinned kernel: yes, libleanshared 5a23395d981dbeeb, read from each file's prover line at build time.

tools/install-lean.sh installs the toolchain through elan (about 2 GB under ~/.elan, not tracked) and compares the kernel, lean, leanchecker and Lake with the pin, as tools/install-tlaps.sh does for the prover.
Regenerates byte for byte: each results.sh was run twice on 2026.10.05 and the runs were identical, which is ADR-0053 §7 (a).

Frozen or pinned (ADR-0053 §4): the re-encodings freeze with their base modules on ratification; a successor module gets a successor Lean file. The transcriptions and the floor statement are pinned, not frozen, as Mechanism.tla is: they follow code and a floor that move.
Staleness was tested: one byte appended to admit.rs made tools/lean-sync.sh report mechanism/lean STALE and exit 1; restored, it exited 0.

text.tspan: 3 · Why every results file ends with the replay: the control of 2026.10.05
Step, in a scratch copy of

svg.text: A module adds smuggled : False with the kernel check off (set_option debug.skipKernelTC true, then addDecl),
and derives uses_smuggled : 1 = 2 from it
lake build: builds
refused: a type mismatch, True where False was expected; exit 1
refused, the same; exit 1
leanchecker --fresh on each real package
accepted; exit 0 (about 25 s, 25 s and 48 s)

text.tspan: What the control shows (ADR-0053 finding 1; proof-method.md §5b)

svg.text: An axiom list is a statement about the declarations the environment holds, not about whether the kernel checked them. A results file with only #print axioms would have certified a
proof of 1 = 2.
The replay re-checks every stored constant through the kernel, so a declaration that entered past it is found. It is the same kernel in a fresh process: an independent kernel (lean4lean)
is an open obligation, as ethos is the independent checker for cvc5's proofs.
The corpus's other checkers carry the same kind of control: three lying solvers for floor/cvc5-checked, four stand-in solvers for spec/smt-checked.

text.tspan: 4 · Two routes to the same theorems: every proof module

svg.text: The TLAPS columns are read from the certified results files, as H6 reads them; the Lean column from spec/lean's results file. A row is red where the TLAPS proof does not certify: its theorems are then proved twice, once by TLAPS with an uncertified step and once in Lean with every step kernel-checked, of the encoding.

text.tspan: Why two routes, and why the table's premises do not change

svg.text: The two routes fail in different places: TLAPS on LS4 and its front end, Lean on the encoding. A theorem proved by both is wrong only if both fail.
The premise table cannot say so (ADR-0053 §5, finding 2). It computes holds = ¬(B·¬d), a conjunction of premises; two proofs give "T-0045-31, or T-0045-37 and the
encoding". So no premise moves: the table keeps T-0045-31 and names the Lean file in its *Checked in* column, as evidence.
The floor's totality is the exception that changes what it rests on: from cedar's folding code to the model's proved validator and T-0045-3, which already reads "the Cedar
engine, as faithful to the Lean model".

sources; cedar-spec by tag and commit
The kernel's soundness is unexamined here, as the prover's is in T-0045-31; the replay is the same kernel, not an independent one. native_decide trusts the compiler, in
floor/lean only. The fidelity of each encoding, transcription and parse is read, not checked: no TLA+ semantics in Lean and no Rust-to-Lean translator was used.
cedar-spec's own theorems are kernel-checked with the rest; its model's fidelity to the engine is T-0045-3

byte for byte

Both rows are read from ADR-0053 §3 at build time. ADR-0045 is pinned by the reference's drift test (mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256) and changes only by a History row at ratification, so the row lands there then, with the re-pin, and not before. T-0045-31's row does not change: the TLAPS proofs still rest on LS4 and, for three modules, on Z3.

text.tspan: 7 · On ratification, what it found, and what is open

svg.text: ADR-0045: Annex A gains T-0045-37 and Annex B its instance, as §3 writes them. Annex B's T-0045-28 note gains: "Two functions of the reference are proved
in Lean of a transcription (ADR-0053): admit.rs's composition and clock.rs's subtracting interval. That is evidence for those functions, not a refinement; the
row is unchanged." Annex B's T-0045-3 note gains: "The floor's totality is proved in Lean under the model this row names (ADR-0053); what the row then carries
for totality is the engine's fidelity to the model, and no longer cedar's term folding." A History row of kind Ratification (dependent entry). No decision text
changes. Re-pinned in mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256.
ADR-0046: a History row of the same kind naming §4's spec package and results file as a second route to the theorems of twelve of its proof modules, including
the two its A1 does not certify. No decision text changes.
ADR-0030: a History row of the same kind naming floor/lean/ and its results file for §5's totality, non-vacuity and discrimination gates, and §1's composition
for mechanism/lean/. Re-pinned.
ADR-0032: a History row of the same kind naming mechanism/lean/Topak/Clock.lean for §2's "fails closed". Re-pinned.
ADR-0033: a History row of the same kind naming the code-level proofs as evidence toward its debt, which stays open. Re-pinned.
spec/theorem-premise-binding.md and spec/theorem-premise-binding.json, as §5 writes them; inventory.py --check passes after.
The next checkpoint's §8 reads, beside ADR-0046's sentence: twelve modules' invariants are also proved in Lean of a re-encoding, on T-0045-37; two
functions of the reference and the floor's totality are proved in Lean of a transcription and under Cedar's model.
The glossary gains proved in Lean, re-encoding, transcription and replay as this record uses them.
The manifests: the three packages and tools/LEAN-PIN enter the next checkpoint manifest, as tools/TLAPS-PIN did; tools/install-lean.sh,
tools/lean-report.sh and tools/lean-sync.sh are excluded, as the scripts under tools/ already are. mechanism/lean/ enters the reference manifests
with mechanism/.
#print axioms misses a declaration added past the kernel. The control in §2: a theorem resting on False, added with the kernel check off, reports no axioms.
The replay refuses it. A results file without the replay would have certified it.
The premise table cannot say "either proof". Its form is a conjunction of premises; two independent proofs give a disjunction. §5 keeps the table conjunctive
and records the second route as evidence.
Confinement needs no bound on Declared. The TLAPS proofs assume Declared ∈ 0..3; the Lean proofs hold for every natural, with no assumption. The
theorem is stronger than its statement, as ADR-0046 found for Coupling's K < R.
The model's entity validator expects the schema's action entities in the store, which the Rust engine adds implicitly. gen.py writes them in. The API
surfaces differ there; the semantics do not.
A toolchain tag floats, as TLAPS's pre-release did: elan's stable resolved to a version not installed. Every package names its toolchain in lean-toolchain,
and the pin fixes the binaries by digest.
An independent kernel for the replay: lean4lean, whose interface matches leanchecker's. It would make the replay an independent check, as ethos is for
cvc5's proofs.
A translator for the transcriptions, Aeneas or hax, when a function longer than compose is to be proved.
The premise table's disjunction (finding 2): whether the matrix should carry alternative premise sets.
The modules not yet encoded: RunCoupling, RunConfinement, Labels, ToolList, Operators, Correlator, Emergency, BreakGlass_A1,
NonComposition_A1. tools/lean-sync.sh lists them.
native_decide in the floor package: whether the model's maps and sets can be reduced by the kernel, or the closed evaluations proved another way.
A second platform: the pin is arm64-darwin; a Linux digest set is owed when the corpus is run there.

The custodian ratifies this record when, on the custodian's machine, (a) tools/install-lean.sh reports the pin matched, and each of the three results.sh regenerates the results file §4 cites byte for byte; (b) tools/lean-sync.sh exits 0; (c) one mutation per package, chosen by the custodian, fails to build in a scratch copy, and the replay control of §2 is refused; and (d) the custodian reads one transcription against its source, since fidelity is the premise this record adds and nothing
checks it: mechanism/lean/Topak/Admit.lean against admit.rs lines 64 to 87 is the shortest.

Mutation checks, 2026.10.05 (each package's README): nine mutated encodings of the small modules and nine of the parameterized ones, three of the code (M_OVERRIDE, M_ERR, R4) and two of the floor (a type error in B1, a permit-all). Each fails to build in the theorem its mutation breaks. Mutations and witnesses as behaviours stay with TLC, as ADR-0046 §2 says of the TLAPS proofs.
